classification_reasons: The instructions and the demonstration images conflict on setup. The text says to sit at a low pulley row station with the hips slid back and the knees slightly bent. The frames show a standing lifter leaning back, with the cable running up to a high pulley.

The setup changes the variant identity and the stabilization demands. A seated lifter does not need standing postural control, but a standing, leaning lifter does. It also changes the pull line and the base of support.
The cable height and body position are not resolved by the metadata, so the variant slug cannot be set faithfully.

Should the definition follow the written instructions or the demonstration images where they differ?
